run_prior_emb2emb: run the KandinskyV22PriorEmb2EmbPipeline to generate image embeddings from a text prompt and reference image
interpolate_embeddings: interpolate between text prompts and images using weighted KandinskyV22PriorEmb2EmbPipeline to produce blended image embeddings
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the KandinskyV22PriorEmb2EmbPipeline _encode_prompt method
encode_image: encode a PIL image or tensor into CLIP image embeddings using the KandinskyV22PriorEmb2EmbPipeline _encode_image method
get_zero_embed: generate a zero image embedding for negative guidance using the KandinskyV22PriorEmb2EmbPipeline get_zero_embed method
